sources.title: gpjt/jax-with-mha-bias-larger-chinchilla-1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model had its number of parameters scaled up so that if it was trained with the Chinchilla-optimal number of tokens, it would approximately the same compute cost to train as a 2x overtrained model like gpjt/jax-with-mha-bias-no-dropout-extended or gpjt/jax-with-mha-bias-no-dropout-2-epoch. So it's somewhere between GPT-2 small and GPT-2 medium in its number of parameters.
